notes: You can now say exactly what day it is. The story clock could only be nudged — a quarter hour, an hour, next morning — which is no use when the story starts on a particular date. The time sheet now has a day-and-time picker alongside the jump buttons, with a line underneath reading back what you are about to set it to, so 'Thursday afternoon, 12:00 PM' is confirmed before you commit to it. The two controls agree by construction: tapping a jump fills the picker in, and Set always applies whatever the picker says. Choosing a day earlier than conversations you have already played moves that history back with the clock, by the same amount for every message, so the past keeps its shape and stays in the past instead of stranding yesterday's evening in next week.
